check-command.description: Required. Command to run code quality and build checks.

node-version.description: Optional. Explicit Node.js version, overriding node-version-file. Omit to use the version declared in this repository's .tool-versions.

node-version-file.description: Optional. Path to a file declaring the Node.js version, relative to the repository root. Defaults to .tool-versions. Ignored when node-version is provided.

setup-command.description: Optional. Shell command to run after dependency installation and bootstrap, before the check command. Use for installing system dependencies. The consumer is responsible for sudo, package-manager flags, and any necessary index updates (e.g., apt-get update).

shellspec-version.description: Optional. Shellspec release to install before the checks run (e.g. 0.28.1). Omit to install nothing. The installer comes from the named release's own tag.
